# Harness support matrix

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-harness-matrix.mjs from docs/adapters/manifests/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

What AMC claims for each agent harness, from its adapter claim manifest. An adapter claims enforcement only at the
hooks listed as enforced, and only at the qualified versions; every enforced hook is backed by passing cases in the
cited qualification record. Everything else is observed or not covered. The support policy is in
[SUPPORT_POLICY.md](SUPPORT_POLICY.md).

| Harness | Package | Qualified versions | Enforced at | Observed at | Status | Qualification record |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| claude-code | `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` | 2.1.296 | `PreToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit` | `SessionStart`, `PostToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, `Stop` | enforced at listed hooks | `qualification/2026-10-18-P1-23/claude-code-conformance.json` (2026-10-18, sha256 `7adc12dc0f1b`) |
| codex | `@openai/codex` | none (source pin `360319d8`) | none | `PostToolUse` | observe only, no qualified version | none |
| dsh | `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | none (source pin `c389f96b`) | none | `launch (process boundary)`, `gateway (model traffic)` | observe only, no qualified version | none |
| pi | `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` | 1.0.2, 1.0.4 | `tool_call` | `tool_result` | enforced at listed hooks | `qualification/2026-10-18-P1-22/pi-conformance.json` (2026-10-18, sha256 `d421dee04466`) |

## Per hook

### claude-code

| Hook | Role | Tools | On hook failure | Backing cases | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PreToolUse` | enforce | Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, Bash (pure form only), every other tool name (denied) | blocks | `recorded-version`, `allowed-read-runs`, `denied-bash-no-effect`, `denied-write-no-effect`, `unmapped-mcp-tool-no-effect`, `hook-settings-protected`, `foreign-hook-not-governed`, `bridge-stopped-blocks`, `receipts-verified` | docs/adapters/claude-code-hooks.md |
| `UserPromptSubmit` | enforce | prompt admission (no tool) | blocks | `frozen-workspace-blocks-prompt`, `bridge-stopped-no-model-request` | docs/adapters/claude-code-hooks.md |
| `SessionStart` | observe | none | proceeds | none | docs/adapters/claude-code-hooks.md |
| `PostToolUse` | observe | Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, Bash | proceeds | none | docs/adapters/claude-code-hooks.md |
| `PostToolUseFailure` | observe | Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, Bash | proceeds | none | docs/adapters/claude-code-hooks.md |
| `Stop` | observe | none | proceeds | none | docs/adapters/claude-code-hooks.md |

Not covered:

- OS containment and Claude Code's own sandbox
- sessions in which Claude Code ran none of AMC's hooks, and sessions without a registration (not governed)
- every hook AMC does not install
- Linux and Windows binaries (Linux packages pinned, not run against AMC; Windows not verified)
- commands an allowed call starts

### codex

| Hook | Role | Tools | On hook failure | Backing cases | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `PostToolUse` | observe | every tool Codex reports at PostToolUse | proceeds | none | docs/adapters/codex.md |

Not covered:

- every Codex tool call is uncontrolled: Codex 0.165.0's PreToolUse lets a call run when its hook fails, so AMC installs no Codex control hook; see docs/source-reviews/P2-17-codex-hooks.md
- no Codex version is qualified: the observe hook has no recorded run of the pinned Codex binary
- calls Codex does not report at PostToolUse, and sessions where Codex has not trusted the project hook
- tool input and output contents (AMC records their SHA-256 only)

### dsh

| Hook | Role | Tools | On hook failure | Backing cases | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `launch (process boundary)` | observe | none | unknown | none | docs/adapters/deepseek-harness.md |
| `gateway (model traffic)` | observe | none | unknown | none | docs/adapters/deepseek-harness.md |

Not covered:

- every DSH tool call: AMC's plugin, Bridge provider, session registration and installer exist, but no DSH version is qualified and the pinned DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (pre-release, pending Sid's acceptance) has no recorded run, so the Bridge denies every DSH call and nothing is claimed; see docs/source-reviews/P2-17-dsh-plugin.md
- DSH sessions that did not load the plugin (an unresolvable plugin entry is skipped, not fatal)
- DSH's own sandbox and approval settings (AMC does not rely on them)
- custom plugins, changed profiles and direct web requests outside the gateway
- the exec-by-path window after the last launcher hash

### pi

| Hook | Role | Tools | On hook failure | Backing cases | Contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tool_call` | enforce | read, grep, find, ls, write, edit, bash, every other tool name (denied) | blocks | `allowed-read-runs`, `allowed-read-version`, `denied-write-no-effect`, `denied-bash-no-effect`, `unmapped-tool-no-effect`, `builtin-override-no-effect`, `bridge-stopped-blocks`, `receipts-verified` | docs/adapters/pi.md |
| `tool_result` | observe | read, grep, find, ls, write, edit, bash | unknown | `outcome-bound-to-decision` | docs/adapters/pi.md |

Not covered:

- OS containment: Pi has no sandbox, and extensions run with the rights of the account that started Pi
- effects that bypass tool_call: another extension's own I/O, Pi Durable
- an extension that rewrites Pi's tool registry itself
- sessions in which Pi did not load AMC's extension (reported as not governed)
- commands an allowed call starts
